summary: Iteration 2 — focused testing of new endpoints (transport cost, auctions calendar, price-breakdown with branch+non-runner) and new UI pages (/auto/auctions, /auto/damaged, /auto/end-of-life, /auto/buynow, /auto/terms, /auto/fees with city dropdown). All 11 backend tests pass; all targeted frontend flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_auctions_service.summary_by_day() emits buckets keyed 'events'/'lots' (not 'count'). Documented but worth aligning naming with /api/auto/auctions/calendar top-level 'count' to reduce confusion.
Transport fallback to legacy NZ$500 happens silently when branch_or_city is provided but unmatched — UI shows 'matched=false' but consider surfacing a 'fallback default' note in PriceBreakdown.
/api/auto/auctions/calendar performs an in-process scrape on cold cache — first call from a fresh DB may take 10–20s. Consider warming during seed_auto.py.
test_credentials: admin@buyanywhere.com / admin12345 ; client@buyanywhere.com / client12345 (verified) ; client2@buyanywhere.com / client12345
seed_data_creation: Tests create one ephemeral NZ vehicle with location='Веллингтон' and hard-delete it at end. Admin refresh of Turners calendar performed (live network access available; 47 events for Turners across 21 days at test time).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints + UI verified PASS. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_auto_iteration2.py. Note: by_day buckets use key 'events' (not 'count'); the test handles both. The Turners scraper works against the live site at test time and returns 47 events / 1255+ lots. /auto/fees Christchurch + non-runner shows NZ$2,500 transport, NZ$15,683 total — matches the price-breakdown API exactly. Vehicle card alignment verified: cta_tops are equal within each row (947.30 / 1380.28).
verified_features: GET /api/auto/auctions/calendar?days_ahead=21 returns {count:47, events:[...], by_day:[...]} with bucket sum == count, source='turners', valid ISO starts_at, lots:int, auction_url contains turners.co.nz
POST /api/auto/admin/auctions/refresh without token => 401 (HTTPBearer); with admin token => 200 with {fetched:int, by_category:{cars:int>=0}, at:iso}

POST /api/auto/price-breakdown {vehicle_price_nzd:8000, branch_or_city:'Christchurch', is_non_runner:true} => local_transport_nzd:2500, transport_detail.runner_nzd:1250, multiplier:2.0, total_nzd:15683
GET /api/auto/vehicles/{id} with Russian location 'Веллингтон' returns 200 with price_breakdown.transport_detail populated (transport_nzd non-null, matched may be false — graceful)
Frontend /auto/auctions: auctions-calendar-grid (21-day strip), auctions-summary '47 аукционов · 1 256 лотов', auctions-table list — all render
Frontend admin login → /auto/auctions shows auctions-refresh-btn; click triggers refresh, summary re-renders
Frontend /auto/damaged: category-hero-damaged with title 'Повреждённые', source badges, count, filters sidebar — render
Frontend /auto/end-of-life: category-hero-eol renders (grid populated, no empty state since donors exist)
Frontend /auto/terms: all 8 sections terms-section-1..8 and terms-acceptance render
Frontend search hero tiles: search-cat-calendar, search-cat-damaged, search-cat-eol, search-cat-buynow, search-cat-auctions all present (1 each)
Frontend /auto/catalog vehicle cards: 12 cards × 12 ctas; cta_tops align horizontally per row (947.30 row1, 1380.28 row2)
Frontend /auto/fees: fees-city dropdown + fees-non-runner checkbox; selecting Christchurch + checking non-runner updates breakdown to NZ$2,500 transport / NZ$15,683 total with '×2 не на ходу' badge
